title: Docket coverage and case posture intake contract

matter_id.description: The authorized matter and its exact court/docket identifiers; captions alone do not establish identity.

docket_manifests.description: Captured entry lists, retrieval times, pagination/limits and document availability status for each docket.

items.description: Source/record descriptor; resolve its identity, access and content via a host-validated adapter.

issue_and_as_of.description: Question, requested date and included proceedings; specify whether historical or current verification is requested.

prior_snapshot.description: Earlier immutable capture for a change report; absence means no change-since claim.

$comment: The host must validate nested source descriptors against its actual DTOs. This specification deliberately does not fabricate production API shapes.
